assertion.name: Spread in crowded congregate settings
assertion.description: Sustained person-to-person spread produces adenovirus outbreaks where people are in prolonged close contact - schools, military training centres and other congregate settings - which is where severe respiratory adenovirus disease in otherwise healthy people is concentrated.

selected_evidence.snippet: Comparison of HAdV incidence rates during school terms and vacations showed that schools are the primary transmission setting for HAdV species B.
